name: Hassan Taj
overview: Senior Software Engineer and Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert focused on platform engineering, cloud architecture, identity, distributed systems, and the modernization of enterprise software.
about_intro: I have 7+ years of experience delivering enterprise applications, cloud solutions, and modernization initiatives. My work has evolved from building individual features to designing the platforms, integrations, and engineering practices that enable teams to deliver reliable software.
about_tech: My implementation background is primarily in .NET, Angular, React, and TypeScript, supported by experience with Azure, AWS, microservices, GraphQL, gRPC, API gateways, databases, containers, CI/CD, and modern identity standards.
about_desc: I care about the full lifecycle of a system: architecture, security, deployment, observability, recovery, documentation, and developer experience. I also explore specification-driven and AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering quality without replacing sound technical judgment.
